name: Groups
description: Several agents in one conversation, as in LobeHub's group chat: a manager agent picks who speaks next, an @mention of an agent wins, and at most a set number of agent turns follow one user message. Each agent answers with a full turn of its own in its own session for the group. A Groups page in the Control UI. Group chats in ordinary chats: with the ai-workbench OpenClaw fork, "Add to group chat" adds an OpenClaw agent, an ACP agent or a model to a chat as a separate participant, and a message naming it (@name, or the "Ask <name>" chip) is answered by it, written into the chat under its own name.
